text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Hrawi says he will propose to the Lebanese parliament a number of constitutional amendments.
-President Clinton congratulated Hrawi on the 53rd Independence day. He told him: "We will continue working in the region until we achieve full and comprehensive peace."
-The central bank to cut treasury bill yields by two percent by the end of the year.
-Protesters against closure of private radio and television stations demonstrate outside parliament for duration of policy debate.
-Minister Jumblatt joined other opposition parliamentary deputies in asking the interior ministry to allow a planned demonstration on Thursday by the Confederation of General Labour.
-Mock Israeli air raids over south Lebanon.
-Lebanese pound continued its weekly slow movement, improving by 0.03 percent.
